explanation.headline: Mesalamine 0.375 g capsules are not on FDA's shortage list; supply at Corvale East is 5.5 days and a transfer from Corvale Lakeside can raise it to 8 days

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows mesalamine is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 49 capsules at 9 per day, giving 5.5 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 50 capsules at 1.8 per day, giving 27.4 days on hand.
The top-ranked option is to transfer 24 capsules from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, which would leave Lakeside with 14 days and raise East to 8 days.
The label for that NDC names Zydus Lifesciences Limited as the registered plant (FEI 3007938603) with a VAI inspection on 2023-03-24.

rejected.text: All three Corvale sites use the same NDC 70771162507 labeled by Zydus Lifesciences Limited.
rejected.reason: "three" is a number in words; numbers must be digits from the evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
